name: Like Button
description: Heart button on track rows. Half heart: another version is liked.

name: Release Date
description: Release year next to the playing track's title.

name: Genre Tags
description: Genres in the now playing bar, linked to 'The Sound of' playlists.

name: Playing From
description: Shows the playlist or album you are playing from. Click to open it.

name: Copy Track Titles
description: Right-click tracks to copy them as 'Artist - Title'.

name: Random Playlist
description: Button that plays a random playlist from your library.

name: Folder Breadcrumb
description: Folder path at the top of a playlist. Click to jump to the folder.

name: Folder Alt Click
description: Alt-click a folder arrow to collapse or expand all its subfolders.

name: Menu Dividers
description: Extra dividers that group the track right-click menu.
